about_the_game:
Become the Ultimate Cyber Sentinel!

Dive into Cyber Sentinel, an electrifying cyberpunk hacking shooter that throws you headfirst into a relentless digital battlefield. As a rogue hacker, you are the last line of defense against waves of sophisticated AI threats within a sprawling, neon-drenched arena.

Engage in High-Octane Combat:
Infiltrate secure networks and dismantle advanced defenses using a futuristic arsenal. Master fast-paced, twin-stick style shooting with dynamic weapons and devastating special abilities. Every shot counts, every dodge matters.

Customize Your Arsenal:

  • Upgrade Your Rig: Enhance attack speed, boost pulse power, and sharpen agility through a robust upgrade system. Adapt your build on the fly to counter evolving threats.

  • Diverse Firepower: Experiment with unique weapon attack patterns like spiral, wave, and burst modes. Find the perfect tool for digital destruction.

  • Unleash Hacker Abilities: Turn the tide with powerful skills like Code Injection, System Overload, EMP Blasts, Nano Swarm deployments, Digital Shields, and Network Distortion.

Immersive Cyberpunk World:
Experience seamless combat with responsive keyboard and gamepad controls. Lose yourself in a stunning neon-cyan aesthetic, brought to life by dynamic visual effects, fluid animations, and energetic particle systems that pulse with futuristic energy.

Master the Arena:
Face down relentless waves of enemies and conquer epic, multi-phase boss battles that will test your skills, strategy, and reflexes. Strategically manage your upgrades, master your weapons, and outsmart your digital adversaries to survive.

Prepare for a new era of cyber warfare. Wishlist Cyber Sentinel! today and dominate the digital frontier!

Default Controls

Cyber Sentinel supports both Keyboard/Mouse and Gamepad input.

Keyboard Controls

Core Movement:

  • W / Up Arrow: Move Up

  • S / Down Arrow: Move Down

  • A / Left Arrow: Move Left

  • D / Right Arrow: Move Right

Combat:

  • Space: Fire Weapon

  • 1-0: Switch Weapons

  • Shift: System Overload Ability

  • F: EMP Blast Ability

  • E: Digital Shield Ability

  • X: Network Distortion Ability

  • Q: Nano Swarm Ability

  • V: Virus Injection Ability

Menus & Utilities:

  • B: Toggle Upgrade Menu

  • P: Pause / Unpause Game

  • Tab: Switch Music Track

  • M: Toggle Music

  • Esc: Close Current Menu / Back

  • Arrow Keys: Navigate Menu Items

  • Enter: Confirm Selection

Upgrade Menu Specific:

  • 1 / 2 / 3: Select Upgrade Option 1 / 2 / 3

  • Space / Enter: Confirm Selection

  • R: Reroll Upgrades (if available)

  • Arrow Keys: Navigate Between Upgrades

Weapon Shop Specific:

  • W / S / Up / Down Arrow: Navigate Up / Down

  • Space / Enter: Purchase Selected Weapon

  • Esc: Exit Shop

  • Tab: Switch Categories (if applicable)

Special Screens:

  • Demo Complete: Enter/Space (Restart), Esc (Exit)

  • Game Over: Enter/Space (Retry), Esc (Exit), Tab (Stats)

  • Language Select: Arrow Keys (Navigate), Enter (Confirm), Esc (Close)

Gamepad Controls (Standard Layout)

(Button numbers reference the index below)

Core Movement:

  • Left Stick (Axes 0, 1): Analog Movement

  • D-Pad (Buttons 12-15): Digital 8-Way Movement

Combat:

  • RT / Right Trigger (Button 7): Fire Weapon

  • A Button (Button 0): Alternative Fire (If applicable)

  • RB / Right Bumper (Button 5): System Overload Ability

  • Y Button (Button 3): EMP Blast Ability

  • B Button (Button 1): Digital Shield Ability

  • X Button (Button 2): Network Distortion Ability

  • LB / Left Bumper (Button 4): Nano Swarm Ability

  • (Virus Injection not listed for default gamepad - check in-game options if available)

Menus & Utilities:

  • Start Button (Button 9): Pause / Unpause Game

  • Back / Select Button (Button 8): Open Upgrade Menu

  • D-Pad (Buttons 12-15): Navigate Menu Options

  • Left Stick (Axes 0, 1): Navigate Menu Options

  • A Button (Button 0): Select / Confirm

  • B Button (Button 1): Back / Cancel

Upgrade Menu Specific:

  • D-Pad / Left Stick: Navigate Upgrades

  • A Button (Button 0): Select Upgrade

  • B Button (Button 1): Close Menu / Select Third Upgrade*

  • LB / Left Bumper (Button 4): Reroll Upgrades

  • RB / Right Bumper (Button 5): Skip Upgrade

  • Y Button (Button 3): Select First Upgrade*

  • X Button (Button 2): Select Second Upgrade*
    *(Note: Possible overlap/priority with B=Back - verify final implementation)

Weapon Shop Specific:

  • Left Stick / D-Pad: Navigate Weapons

  • A Button (Button 0): Purchase Weapon

  • B Button (Button 1): Exit Shop

  • LB / RB (Buttons 4, 5): Switch Categories (if applicable)

Special Screens:

  • Demo Complete: A Button (Restart), B Button (Exit)

  • Game Over: A Button (Retry), B Button (Exit), Y Button (Stats)

  • Language Select: D-Pad/Left Stick (Navigate), A Button (Confirm), B Button (Close)
